title: TRIB3-TRIM8 complex drives NAFLD progression by regulating HNF4alpha stability.
authors: Xiao, Meng-Chao; Jiang, Nan; Chen, Li-Lin; Liu, Fang; Liu, Shu-Qing; Ding, Chen-Hong; Wu, Si-Han; Wang, Ke-Qi; Luo, Yuan-Yuan; Peng, Yu; Yan, Fang-Zhi; Zhang, Xin; Qian, Hui; Xie, Wei-Fen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TRIB3-TRIM8复合物调控HNF4alpha蛋白稳定性在NAFLD中的作用，虽涉及转录因子HNF4alpha，但核心是泛素化降解机制，无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅用分子对接辅助肽设计，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress of hepatocytes plays a causative role in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). Reduced expression of hepatic nuclear factor 4alpha (HNF4alpha) is a critical event in the pathogenesis of NAFLD and other liver diseases. Whether ER stress regulates HNF4alpha expression remains unknown. The aim of this study was to delineate the machinery of HNF4alpha protein degradation and explore a therapeutic strategy based on protecting HNF4alpha stability during NAFLD progression. METHODS: Correlation of HNF4alpha and tribbles homologue 3 (TRIB3), an ER stress sensor, was evaluated in human and mouse NAFLD tissues. RNA-sequencing, mass spectrometry analysis, co-immunoprecipitation, in vivo and in vitro ubiquitination assays were used to elucidate the mechanisms of TRIB3-mediated HNF4alpha degradation. Molecular docking and co-immunoprecipitation analyses were performed to identify a cell-penetrating peptide that ablates the TRIB3-HNF4alpha interaction. RESULTS: TRIB3 directly interacts with HNF4alpha and mediates ER stress-induced HNF4alpha degradation. TRIB3 recruits tripartite motif containing 8 (TRIM8) to form an E3 ligase complex that catalyzes K48-linked polyubiquitination of HNF4alpha on lysine 470. Abrogating the degradation of HNF4alpha attenuated the effect of TRIB3 on a diet-induced NAFLD model. Moreover, the TRIB3 gain-of-function variant p.Q84R is associated with NAFLD progression in patients, and induces lower HNF4alpha levels and more severe hepatic steatosis in mice. Importantly, disrupting the TRIB3-HNF4alpha interaction using a cell-penetrating peptide restores HNF4alpha levels and ameliorates NAFLD progression in mice. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings unravel the machinery of HNF4alpha protein degradation and indicate that targeting TRIB3-TRIM8 E3 complex-mediated HNF4alpha polyubiquitination may be an ideal strategy for NAFLD therapy. IMPACT AND IMPLICATIONS: Reduced expression of hepatic nuclear factor 4alpha (HNF4alpha) is a critical event in the pathogenesis of NAFLD and other liver diseases. However, the mechanism of HNF4alpha protein degradation remains unknown. Herein, we reveal that TRIB3-TRIM8 E3 ligase complex is responsible for HNF4alpha degradation during NAFLD. Inhibiting the TRIB3-HNF4alpha interaction effectively stabilized HNF4alpha protein levels and transcription factor activity in the liver and ameliorated TRIB3-mediated NAFLD progression. Our findings demonstrate that disturbing the TRIM8-TRIB3-HNF4alpha interaction may provide a novel approach to treat NAFLD and even other liver diseases by stabilizing the HNF4alpha protein.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：肝细胞的内质网（endoplasmic reticulum, ER）应激在非酒精性脂肪性肝病（non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, NAFLD）中起致病作用。肝细胞核因子4α（hepatic nuclear factor 4alpha, HNF4alpha）表达降低是NAFLD及其他肝脏疾病发病机制中的关键事件。ER应激是否调控HNF4alpha表达尚不清楚。本研究旨在阐明HNF4alpha蛋白降解的机制，并探索基于保护HNF4alpha稳定性以应对NAFLD进展的治疗策略。方法：在人类和小鼠NAFLD组织中评估HNF4alpha与ER应激传感器tribbles同源物3（tribbles homologue 3, TRIB3）的相关性。采用RNA测序、质谱分析、免疫共沉淀、体内外泛素化实验来阐明TRIB3介导的HNF4alpha降解机制。通过分子对接和免疫共沉淀分析，鉴定一种可消除TRIB3-HNF4alpha相互作用的细胞穿透肽。结果：TRIB3直接与HNF4alpha相互作用，并介导ER应激诱导的HNF4alpha降解。TRIB3招募含三方基序蛋白8（tripartite motif containing 8, TRIM8）形成E3连接酶复合物，该复合物催化HNF4alpha在赖氨酸470位点的K48连接的多聚泛素化。消除HNF4alpha降解可减弱TRIB3对饮食诱导NAFLD模型的影响。此外，TRIB3功能获得性变异p.Q84R与患者NAFLD进展相关，并在小鼠中诱导更低的HNF4alpha水平和更严重的肝脂肪变性。重要的是，使用细胞穿透肽破坏TRIB3-HNF4alpha相互作用可恢复HNF4alpha水平，并改善小鼠NAFLD进展。结论：我们的发现揭示了HNF4alpha蛋白降解的机制，并表明靶向TRIB3-TRIM8 E3复合物介导的HNF4alpha多聚泛素化可能是NAFLD治疗的理想策略。影响与意义：肝细胞核因子4α（HNF4alpha）表达降低是NAFLD及其他肝脏疾病发病机制中的关键事件。然而，HNF4alpha蛋白降解的机制尚不清楚。在此，我们揭示TRIB3-TRIM8 E3连接酶复合物在NAFLD期间负责HNF4alpha降解。抑制TRIB3-HNF4alpha相互作用可有效稳定肝脏中HNF4alpha蛋白水平和转录因子活性，并改善TRIB3介导的NAFLD进展。我们的发现表明，干扰TRIM8-TRIB3-HNF4alpha相互作用可能通过稳定HNF4alpha蛋白，为治疗NAFLD甚至其他肝脏疾病提供一种新方法。
